title: A busy day
subtitle: Lucas's crazy Friday — irregular verbs and didn't
canDo: I can use common irregular verbs: went, had, got up, bought …
I can say what I didn't do.
I can tell the story of a busy day.
teacherNotes: Düzensiz fiiller: tabloyu tek seferde ezberletmeye çalışmayın. Bu dersteki 16 fiil yeter; her derste 3–4 yenisini ekleyin.
didn't + yalın fiil kuralı çok önemli: "I didn't went" hatası hem Türklerde hem Araplarda çok yaygın.
Hikâye zinciri oyunu: öğretmen "Yesterday I got up at six …" diye başlar, her öğrenci bir cümle ekler (and then I went / had / saw …).
Omar'ın günlüğü 8.1'deki sahneyle bağlantılı: Salı sabahı sınıfta neden uyuduğunu anlatıyor. İsterseniz öğrencilere hatırlatın.

lines.text: I am! Yesterday was a very busy day.

lines.text: Well, I got up at six o'clock.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Six? You never get up at six!

lines.text: I know! I had a coffee, and then I went to the music store with Jake. We bought a new drum for the band.

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Then we took the bus to the café with the drum. It was very big, and the bus was full!

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: At the café, I saw the problem. I didn't have my guitar. I forgot it at home!

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: So I went home again on the bus. I didn't have lunch, and I didn't sit down all day.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: But the concert was great. And Omar sang very well.

sections.intro: Tuesday morning. Omar writes in his diary after work.
paragraphs: Monday night. I came to the hospital at eight in the evening.
There were a lot of sick people, and I didn't sit down all night.
I helped the doctors, and I talked to a lot of families.
At two in the morning, I ate a sandwich and drank a cup of tea.
At six o'clock, a little boy said, “Thank you, Omar.”
That was the best moment of the night.
I left the hospital at seven, and I went to class at nine.
I was very tired, and I slept on my desk. Sorry, Maya!

sections.title: Grammar: irregular verbs and didn't
rules: Many common verbs are irregular: go → **went**, have → **had**. Learn them like new words.
Negative: **didn't** + verb: I **didn't have** lunch. (not I didn't had)
**didn't** = did not. It is the same for all people: I / she / they didn't go.
examples: I went to the music store.

support.tr: Sık kullanılan birçok fiil düzensizdir: -ed almaz, kendine ait bir geçmiş biçimi vardır: go → went (gitti), have → had (vardı / yedi). Bunları yeni kelime gibi öğren. Olumsuz: didn't + fiilin yalın hâli: I didn't have lunch = Öğle yemeği yemedim. didn't'ten sonra fiil geçmiş hâle girmez: didn't went değil, didn't go.
support.ar: كثير من الأفعال الشائعة شاذّة: لا تأخذ ed بل لها صيغة ماضٍ خاصّة: go → went (ذهب)، have → had (كان عنده / تناول). احفظها ككلمات جديدة. النفي: didn't + الفعل في صيغته الأصلية: I didn't have lunch = لم أتناول الغداء. بعد didn't لا نستخدم صيغة الماضي: نقول didn't go وليس didn't went.

tr.note: didn't'ten sonra fiil yalın kalır. Düzensiz fiile -ed ekleme.

ar.note: بعد didn't استخدم الفعل الأصلي، ولا تنفِ الماضي بـ no.

sections.title: Write: A busy day

model.heading: A busy day — Elif
text: Last Saturday was a very busy day.
I got up at seven and went to the café.
There were a lot of customers, and I made fifty coffees!
I didn't have lunch, but Sam gave me a cookie.
At two o'clock, I went home and slept for three hours.

frame: I got up at ___ and went to ___.
sections.prompt: Write about a busy day in your life (5 or 6 sentences). Use didn't one time.

support.ar: اكتب عن يوم مزدحم في حياتك (5 أو 6 جمل). استخدم didn't مرة واحدة.
